name: pulse
description: While a turn runs, shows what Claude is doing above the prompt: current action, tool count, elapsed time. Draws shell commands as compact rows.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: while-active: the band's spinner and the Bash rows' turn while Claude works, and a new action fades in. off: everything stands still (the time still counts). Claude Code's Reduce motion setting stills it too.
